name: scheme-test
description: Tests for the scheme/ sub-app. Never shipped. Render tests need a server at http://localhost:8888 (python3 -m http.server 8888 from the repo root); BASE= overrides it. SCHEME_IDS=<id>[,<id>] narrows every render walk to those cards for a single-card review (about 6s against 72s) and turns the catalog floors and censuses OFF, announcing itself as a SUBSET: the gate is the unfiltered run.
//: Globs, not directories. On Node 22.15.1 `node --test unit/ render/` tries to LOAD each directory as a module and fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before running anything, and a glob that matches nothing exits 0, which is what keeps unit/ and report/ green while they are still empty.
